tips.title: Select BALL NOSE MILL tool for roughing operations
tips.body: BALL NOSE MILL is recommended for contour roughing operations.

tips.title: Set boundary constraints for HSR operations
tips.body: Select 'Constraint boundaries' and choose 'Selected faces' with an offset of 2.

tips.title: Use Adaptive step down for HSR operations
tips.body: Select 'Adaptive step down' and set 'Last levels to even value' as 5.

tips.title: Select Minimal vertical retract for HSR operations
tips.body: Choose 'Minimal vertical retract' and set 'Clear surface by' to 15.

tips.title: Use BULL NOSE MILL for rest roughing operations
tips.body: Select BULL NOSE MILL as the tool for rest roughing operations.

tips.title: Set Z clearance for iMachining operations
tips.body: In the iMachining operation, set 'Z clearance' to 0.08.

tips.title: Optimize Z level for rest roughing operations
tips.body: Select 'Optimize Z level' and set 'Last levels to even value' as 5.

tips.title: Set ramp angle
tips.body: 2 degrees

tips.title: Select tool and holder
tips.body: BALL NOSE MILL, HSK A 63 SRKIN 12x120, HSK A 63 ER 32x80

tips.title: Set retract distance and ramp
tips.body: Use retract distance, Use ramp

tips.title: Set maximum step over
tips.body: 4 units

tips.title: Set cut tolerance
tips.body: 0.1 units

tips.title: Set ramp type
tips.body: Auto

tips.title: Set ramp length (tool diameter %)
Set stock clearance
tips.body: 100 units, Allow tool outside stock checked

tips.title: Set minimum angle change
tips.body: Checked, Second angle pair, Limits all

tips.title: Set maximum angle step
tips.body: 3 degrees, Minimize rotation axis changes checked

tips.title: Set lead-in and lead-out parameters
tips.body: Use Lead-In, Use Lead-Out, Enter parameters as shown in the image

tips.title: Set miscellaneous parameters
tips.body: Enter values as shown in the image

tips.title: Select faces for SWARF Semi Finishing
tips.body: Click 'Floor surfaces' check box and select faces from the image.

tips.title: Copy and paste SWARF operations
tips.body: Right-click the operation > Copy, then Paste.

tips.title: Edit SWARF operations
tips.body: Right-click the operation > Edit.

tips.title: Set tool path strategy to Automatic for SWARF Finishing
tips.body: In the Strategy list, click 'Automatic'.

tips.title: Select TAPER BALL NOSE tool for SWARF Finishing
tips.body: Click 'Tool > Select' and choose the TAPER BALL NOSE tool.

tips.title: Set tool holder for SWARF Finishing
tips.body: Select HSK A 63 ER 32x80 as the holder.

tips.title: Configure Levels for SWARF Finishing
tips.body: Click 'Levels' and enter parameters as shown in the image.

tips.title: Configure Tool path parameters for SWARF Finishing
tips.body: Click 'Tool path parameters' and enter parameters as shown in the image.

tips.title: Configure Tool axis control for SWARF Finishing
tips.body: Set Maximum angle step value to 3 and select 'Minimize rotation axis changes'.

tips.title: Configure Link for SWARF Finishing
tips.body: Click 'Link' and select 'Use Lead-In' and 'Use Lead-Out'.

tips.title: Configure Passes for SWARF Finishing
tips.body: Click 'Passes' and enter parameters as shown in the image.

tips.title: Configure Smoothing for SWARF Finishing
tips.body: Click 'Smoothing tab' and set values as shown in the image.

tips.title: Configure General tab for SWARF Finishing
tips.body: On the 'General tab', set values as shown.

tips.title: Configure Ramping tab for SWARF Finishing
tips.body: Set values on the 'Ramping tab' as shown.

tips.title: Configure Strategy tab for SWARF Finishing
tips.body: Set values on the 'Strategy tab' as shown.

tips.title: Configure Retracts tab for SWARF Finishing
tips.body: Set values on the 'Retracts tab' as shown.

tips.title: Configure Leads tab for SWARF Finishing
tips.body: Set values on the 'Leads tab' as shown.

tips.title: Configure Constraint boundaries for SWARF Finishing
tips.body: Click 'Constraint boundaries' and select 'Created manually'.

tips.title: Configure User-defined boundary for SWARF Finishing
tips.body: Click 'User-defined boundary' and select the boundary as shown in the image.

tips.title: Configure Drive surface for SWARF Finishing
tips.body: Click 'Drive surface' and select the face as shown in the image.

tips.title: Configure Edge curve for SWARF Finishing
tips.body: Click 'Edge curve' and select the curve as shown in the image.

tips.title: Configure Number of cuts for SWARF Finishing
tips.body: In the 'Number of cuts' field, enter a value of 20.

tips.title: Configure Maximum step over for SWARF Finishing
tips.body: In the 'Maximum step over' field, enter a value of 0.7.

tips.title: Configure Sorting tab for SWARF Finishing
tips.body: Click 'Sorting tab' and enter parameters as shown in the image.

tips.title: Set tool axis control parameters
tips.body: Ensure that the parameters on the Regular tab match those shown in the image.

tips.title: Configure side tilt for contour milling
tips.body: Select 'Orthogonal to cut direction at each contour' in the Side tilt definition list on the Side tilt tab.

tips.title: Perform gouge check for tool path
tips.body: Click 'Gouge check' and enter parameters as shown in the image.

tips.title: Add SWARF Machining operation for outer finishing
tips.body: Right-click the operation > Add Milling Operation > SWARF Machining.

tips.title: Select automatic strategy for SWARF surfaces
tips.body: Click 'Automatic' in the Strategy list under SWARF surfaces.

tips.title: Set tool axis control parameters for SWARF finishing
tips.body: Set the Maximum angle step value to 3 on the Tool axis control tab.

tips.title: Edit SWARF finishing operation parameters
tips.body: Click 'Misc. parameters' and enter custom triangulation parameters as shown in the image.

tips.title: Configure gouge check for SWARF finishing operation
tips.body: Unselect 'Custom triangulation' and perform a gouge check with 'Avoid by relinking' set to 'Swarf & additional surfaces'.

tips.title: Select faces for SWARF finishing operation
tips.body: Select all lug faces and perform the same operation to finish machining remaining lugs.

tips.title: Add SWARF Machining operation for lug finishing
tips.body: Right-click the operation > Add Milling Operation > SWARF Machining.

tips.title: Configure tool path parameters for lug finishing
tips.body: Enter values as shown in the image on the Tool path parameters tab.

tips.title: Run simulations for SWARF finishing operations
tips.body: Run simulations after saving and calculating each operation.
